subject: Test harness access lifecycle & dataset usage constraints
messages:
From: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>
To: Priya Sharma <priya@sableanalytics.com>
Cc: Oliver Kane <okane@sableanalytics.com>
Date: Sun, 12 Apr 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Test harness access lifecycle & dataset usage constraints

Hi Priya —

Thanks again for taking the time last week. Per our conversation, attached is a short inventory of the test harness components and an outline of the prompt pack we'd like to exchange for the evaluation run. I want to be explicit about the access lifecycle we recommend so there are no surprises for your security team:

- Delivery: Sable provides sample test cases and prompt pack; Redwood ingests into an ephemeral sandbox.
- Access window: default = 30 days from provisioning; can be shortened to 14 days for high-sensitivity data.
- Ephemeral credentials: scoped tokens with automatic rotation; no long-lived keys.
- Data handling: ingestion is read-only; no persistent copies outside sandbox; KV caches flushed at teardown.
- Audit & logs: we will provide an access log export at close-of-test for your audit.

Proposed milestones (we can put these in a short MAP):
1) Contract & MPA sign-off (legal) — target: 1 week
2) Asset delivery & access provisioning — target: +3 business days after sign-off
3) Evaluation run & monitoring — 7–14 days
4) Takedown & confirmation of destruction — within 48 hours after conclusion

Questions for you:
1) Do you need an even shorter access window or additional NDA language for the prompt pack?
2) Who will be the legal contact at Sable for the MPA?

Attachments:
- test-harness-inventory.csv (CSV)
- prompt-pack-outline.md (Markdown)

Thanks — happy to hop on a 20-min call if useful.

—Grace
Grace O'Connor
Principal Solutions Lead, Redwood Inference
grace.oconnor@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0123

From: Priya Sharma <priya@sableanalytics.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>
Cc: Oliver Kane <okane@sableanalytics.com>
Date: Mon, 13 Apr 2026 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Test harness access lifecycle & dataset usage constraints

Hi Grace —

Appreciate the clear outline. A few quick notes from our side:

- Shorter window: for the prompt pack containing production-like prompts we'd prefer a 14-day window. Is that feasible?
- Legal: please loop in our procurement lead (procurement@sableanalytics.com) — they'll handle the MPA redlines.
- Ephemeral creds: this is fine, but we need token issuance to be scoped by path (no read across other teams' sandboxes).
- Audit export: can you confirm the export format (CSV or JSON) and a sample of what the access log looks like?

We'd also like to request an explicit clause that Redwood will not use the prompt pack material for model fine-tuning, even internally; that's a gating item for us.

Cc'ing Oliver in case he wants to add anything.

Thanks,
Priya
Priya Sharma
Head of Data Science, SableAnalytics
priya@sableanalytics.com
From: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>
To: Priya Sharma <priya@sableanalytics.com>
Cc: Oliver Kane <okane@sableanalytics.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Apr 2026 11:28:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Test harness access lifecycle & dataset usage constraints

Priya —

14 days is fine for the prompt pack. We can add a non-use clause to the MAP: Redwood will not use exchanged prompt packs or test cases for any internal model training or benchmarking outside the scoped evaluation; access will be confined to the ephemeral sandbox and any copies will be deleted at takedown. We'll include specific language your legal team can review.

Access logs: we deliver a CSV summary by default (timestamp, actor, action, resource, request_id). I'll attach a sanitized sample in the next message.

Next steps I propose:
- I will share a one-page MAP draft and an MPA redline for your procurement lead.
- Karthik (cc'd) will follow up on token scoping and the ingest safeguards.

If that works, I can circulate the MAP today and we can aim to sign early next week.

—Grace

Priya — forwarding from Grace with a couple engineering clarifications below.

Karthik here — quick points on token scoping and ingest controls:
- Tokens issued for Sable will be scoped to the sandbox path: /sandbox/sableanalytics/{env}/
- Read-only ingest enforced at the service layer; no write APIs enabled for uploaded assets.
- KV cache policy: TTL=0 for files marked "sensitive"; other test inputs allowed short TTL for performance.
- We will provide a signed attestation of teardown once the sandbox is destroyed.

Attachment: Sable-MAP-draft.docx (draft MAP with timeline and non-use clause).

Let us know if you'd like us to restrict access further (IP ranges, VPN).

Thanks,
Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Director, Product Engineering, Redwood Inference
From: Priya Sharma <priya@sableanalytics.com>

Date: Mon, 26 Apr 2026 15:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Test harness access lifecycle & dataset usage constraints

Karthik/Grace —

Thanks for the clarifications and the MAP draft. Procurement is on copy. Two confirmations before we proceed:

1) Non-use clause: please add the exact line — "Redwood Inference will not use provided evaluation materials (prompt packs, test cases, datasets) for model training, tuning or benchmarking outside of the scoped evaluation and will delete all copies at teardown."
2) Access window: prompt pack = 14 days, other test artifacts = 30 days.

If you agree, procurement will circulate an MPA redline and then we'll route to DocuSign. Please attach the sanitized access log sample when you send the final MAP so we can verify columns.

Once those items are in the MAP, Sable will sign and we can schedule provisioning for the first week of May.

Regards,
Priya
